facts.statement: Free Realms' first birthday (April 29) was celebrated with a large party that started on the posting day and ended May 10.
facts.quote: Am 29. April ist Free Realms erster Geburtstag! Sie geht heute los und endet am 10. Mai.

article_summaries.title: Die Free Realms Geburtstagsfeier! (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A German-language official SOE news post announcing Free Realms' first-anniversary birthday party, running from the launch-day kickoff until May 10, 2010, with party zones, new quests, party items, cakes and a boss fight against Cakenstein. The page is in German; the date is inferred from the capture (posted 6 days 13 hours before 2010-04-28), not printed in the text.
